newsitem.title: USA: US LPGs mostly unchanged ahead of data.
newsitem.headline: US LPGs mostly unchanged ahead of data.

text.p: U.S. spot LPG prices were mostly unchanged in quiet trade late on Wednesday as players stood back to wait for industry stock data due out today.
In the Gulf Coast hub of Mont Belvieu, Texas, propane remained between 39.75 cents and 40.00 cents a gallon, holding on to its intraday loss of 0.75 cent.
Conway, Kansas, hub material also stayed steady at 38.75/39.00 cents, with 39.00 cent parcels sold, players said.
"We've had a few more deals done here today than I've seen in the past few days, but it's still pretty quiet," said one Conway trader.
Players added that the market was difficult to gauge because of the Iraqi headlines that pressured up crude oil futures earlier in the day before settling back down.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859-1631
